info.title: Reclack API
info.description:
Recurring and one-time stablecoin payments, taken straight from your customers' wallets.

Reclack is non-custodial. Payments move from a customer's wallet to a settlement address you control, and Reclack never holds funds and never asks anyone for a seed phrase or a private key.

## Authentication

Send your API key as a bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer rk_live_your_key_here
```

`X-API-Key` and `Api-Key` are accepted too. The key prefix decides the environment: `rk_sandbox_` for test chains, `rk_live_` for production.

## Responses

Objects and lists come back under `data`. Errors come back under `error` with a `type`, an optional `code` and a message written for a person.
